sources.title: Same Weights, Different Robot: A Deployment Safety View of VLA Policies
sources.inspected: Primary HTML: formalization, certificates, experiments and limitations
sources.relationship: Direct prior work: executable-policy identity and quantile normalization-mismatch certificates, with replay evidence. The broad executable-semantics thesis is not our novelty.
sources.remaining_question: No official implementation link identified in bounded primary-paper review; this is not proof of absence. Paper-equation arithmetic is independently implemented and explicitly extended; model-support/controller distinctions are not established by designed processor probes.

sources.title: XPolicyLab: A Unified Standard and Open Ecosystem for Robot Policy Evaluation and Deployment
sources.inspected: Primary HTML: runtime architecture, schema and lifecycle sections
sources.relationship: Policy adapters, shared schemas and isolated runtime/lifecycle orchestration are existing infrastructure. Do not claim those as new.
sources.remaining_question: Inspect executable checks and overlap with partial-evidence conformance; no service/benchmark executed yet.
sources.version_note: The inspected v1 credits the group plus 66 authors. Current v3 has a different author inventory; citations here intentionally retain v1.

sources.title: Automatic Metamorphic Test Oracles for Action-Policy Testing
sources.inspected: Publisher metadata and author-hosted full method reviewed in focused primary-source audit
sources.relationship: Automated metamorphic oracles for learned policies are prior art; distinguish policy-quality testing from adapter meaning. Full method comparison remains pending.

sources.title: CRADLE: Cross-Backend Validation to Detect and Localize Bugs in Deep Learning Libraries
sources.inspected: Author-hosted full paper reviewed in focused primary-source audit; equivalent/differential computations and their oracle limits
sources.relationship: Cross-implementation checking and divergence localization in ML software are established. Agreement between implementations is not an independent physical specification.

sources.title: EAGLE: Creating Equivalent Graphs to Test Deep Learning Libraries
sources.inspected: Author-hosted full paper reviewed in focused primary-source audit; equivalent/differential computations and their oracle limits
sources.relationship: Equivalent-graph rules and single-library differential testing are prior art. Generated equivalent executions alone cannot establish missing physical authority.

sources.inspected: Primary publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata; full text not yet inspected
sources.relationship: Specification/implementation conformance and stateful test-generation foundations are existing theory; no claim to invent model-based testing.

sources.title: Simplifying and Isolating Failure-Inducing Input
sources.relationship: Failure-preserving reduction is prior art. Our local relation witnesses are neither generic delta debugging nor globally minimal causal explanations.

sources.title: Runtime Verification for LTL and TLTL
sources.venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology
sources.relationship: Three-valued finite-trace monitoring is precedent; temporal inconclusiveness differs from our missing-authority UNKNOWN.

follow_up: Bounded primary-source audit does not establish exhaustive literature coverage or novel testing theory.
Current results support a finite reproducible comparison of contracts and evidence limits, with parity and larger compiler witnesses explicitly reported.

Stock full physical preflight, Tether paired rollouts, ActionABI response episodes and concrete XPolicyLab adapter execution remain inapplicable/unexecuted for this metadata stratum; no absence-of-check or superiority claim.
TMLR article format is a candidate based on official criteria reviewed 2026-10-23; human authors must assess scientific interest and review before any separately authorized submission.
